keyPoints.en: Organelles in both cells: nucleus (controls cell), plasma membrane (controls entry/exit), cytoplasm, mitochondria (respiration), ribosomes (protein), ER, Golgi apparatus.
keyPoints.bm: Organel dalam kedua-dua sel: nukleus (kawal sel), membran plasma (kawal keluar masuk), sitoplasma, mitokondria (respirasi), ribosom (protein), JE, jasad Golgi.

keyPoints.en: Animal cells only: centrioles, lysosomes (common), small temporary vacuoles; irregular shape.
keyPoints.bm: Sel haiwan sahaja: sentriol, lisosom (biasa), vakuol kecil sementara; bentuk tidak tetap.

keyPoints.en: Plant cells only: cellulose cell wall, chloroplasts, large central vacuole; fixed shape.
keyPoints.bm: Sel tumbuhan sahaja: dinding sel selulosa, kloroplas, vakuol tengah besar; bentuk tetap.

keyPoints.en: Rough ER + Golgi = making and secreting proteins (enzymes, hormones); smooth ER = lipids, detoxification.
keyPoints.bm: JE kasar + Golgi = menghasil dan merembes protein (enzim, hormon); JE licin = lipid, penyahtoksikan.

keyPoints.en: Cells with high energy needs (sperm, muscle) have many mitochondria.
keyPoints.bm: Sel yang memerlukan banyak tenaga (sperma, otot) mempunyai banyak mitokondria.

question.en: Why do liver cells have a lot of smooth endoplasmic reticulum?
question.bm: Mengapa sel hati mempunyai banyak jalinan endoplasma licin?

answer.en: The liver detoxifies drugs and poisons, a job of smooth ER.
answer.bm: Hati menyahtoksik dadah dan racun, iaitu tugas JE licin.

tip.en: Learn organelles as pairs: structure ↔ function ↔ example of a cell that has many of them.
tip.bm: Pelajari organel secara berpasangan: struktur ↔ fungsi ↔ contoh sel yang banyak mengandunginya.

keyPoints.en: Unicellular organisms carry out all living processes in one cell: nutrition, respiration, excretion, movement, growth, reproduction, response.
keyPoints.bm: Organisma unisel menjalankan semua proses hidup dalam satu sel: nutrisi, respirasi, perkumuhan, pergerakan, pertumbuhan, pembiakan, gerak balas.

keyPoints.en: Amoeba sp.: moves with pseudopodia, feeds by phagocytosis, food vacuoles digest food, contractile vacuole removes excess water.
keyPoints.bm: Amoeba sp.: bergerak dengan pseudopodium, makan secara fagositosis, vakuol makanan mencerna makanan, vakuol mengecut menyingkir air berlebihan.

keyPoints.en: Paramecium sp.: moves with cilia, takes food through the oral groove, two contractile vacuoles.
keyPoints.bm: Paramecium sp.: bergerak dengan silium, mengambil makanan melalui alur mulut, dua vakuol mengecut.

keyPoints.en: Both reproduce asexually by binary fission when conditions are good; Paramecium can also conjugate.
keyPoints.bm: Kedua-duanya membiak secara aseks melalui belahan dedua dalam keadaan baik; Paramecium juga boleh berkonjugasi.

keyPoints.en: Gases (O₂, CO₂) move by diffusion across the plasma membrane.
keyPoints.bm: Gas (O₂, CO₂) bergerak secara resapan merentasi membran plasma.

question.en: What happens to Amoeba's contractile vacuole if placed in sea water?
question.bm: Apakah yang berlaku kepada vakuol mengecut Amoeba jika diletakkan dalam air laut?

answer.en: Less water enters by osmosis, so the contractile vacuole contracts less often.
answer.bm: Kurang air memasuki sel secara osmosis, jadi vakuol mengecut kurang kerap mengecut.

tip.en: Draw Amoeba and Paramecium and label every structure with its process.
tip.bm: Lukis Amoeba dan Paramecium serta label setiap struktur dengan prosesnya.

keyPoints.en: In multicellular organisms, cells specialise — their structure suits a particular function.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam organisma multisel, sel mengalami pengkhususan — strukturnya sesuai dengan fungsi tertentu.

keyPoints.en: Examples: red blood cells (no nucleus, biconcave), nerve cells (long axon), root hair cells (long extension), guard cells (control stoma).
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: sel darah merah (tiada nukleus, dwicekung), sel saraf (akson panjang), sel rambut akar (unjuran panjang), sel pengawal (mengawal stoma).

keyPoints.en: Animal tissues: epithelial, connective, muscle, nerve.
keyPoints.bm: Tisu haiwan: epitelium, penghubung, otot, saraf.

keyPoints.en: Plant tissues: meristematic (dividing) and permanent — epidermal, ground (parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma), vascular (xylem, phloem).
keyPoints.bm: Tisu tumbuhan: meristem (membahagi) dan kekal — epidermis, asas (parenkima, kolenkima, sklerenkima), vaskular (xilem, floem).

question.en: How is a palisade mesophyll cell adapted for photosynthesis?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah sel mesofil palisad diadaptasi untuk fotosintesis?

answer.en: Tall, closely packed near the upper leaf surface, with many chloroplasts to absorb maximum light.
answer.bm: Panjang, tersusun rapat berhampiran permukaan atas daun, dengan banyak kloroplas untuk menyerap cahaya maksimum.

tip.en: Answer 'adaptation' questions with: feature → how it helps the function.
tip.bm: Jawab soalan 'penyesuaian' dengan: ciri → bagaimana ia membantu fungsi.

keyPoints.en: Levels of organisation: cell → tissue → organ → system → organism.
keyPoints.bm: Aras organisasi: sel → tisu → organ → sistem → organisma.

keyPoints.en: Tissue: group of similar cells with the same function (e.g. muscle tissue).
keyPoints.bm: Tisu: sekumpulan sel serupa dengan fungsi yang sama (cth. tisu otot).

keyPoints.en: Organ: different tissues working together (e.g. heart, leaf).
keyPoints.bm: Organ: tisu berbeza yang bekerjasama (cth. jantung, daun).

keyPoints.en: System: organs working together (e.g. digestive system); systems together form the organism.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem: organ yang bekerjasama (cth. sistem pencernaan); sistem-sistem bersama membentuk organisma.

keyPoints.en: Human systems: digestive, respiratory, circulatory, nervous, endocrine, excretory, skeletal, muscular, reproductive, lymphatic, integumentary.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem manusia: pencernaan, respirasi, peredaran, saraf, endokrin, perkumuhan, rangka, otot, pembiakan, limfa, integumen.

question.en: Why is a leaf called an organ?

answer.en: It is made of several tissues (epidermis, mesophyll, xylem, phloem) working together for photosynthesis.
answer.bm: Ia terdiri daripada beberapa tisu (epidermis, mesofil, xilem, floem) yang bekerjasama untuk fotosintesis.

tip.en: The internal environment must be kept constant (homeostasis) for cells to work properly.
tip.bm: Persekitaran dalam mesti dikekalkan malar (homeostasis) supaya sel berfungsi dengan baik.
